content.name: Ethnicity
content.label: Which race(s) or ethnicity do you consider yourself to be?
content.scripting:
Ethnicity "Which race(s) or ethnicity do you consider yourself to be?"
    [
        ShortName = "S6",
        FullName = "S6_Ethnicity",
        Logic = "Show to all.",
        RespondentLogic = "Show to respondent.",
        RI = "standard"
    ]
categorical [1..]
{
    AmericanIndianAlaskan "American Indian or Alaskan Native",
    AsianIncludesAsian "Asian (includes Asian Indian, Chinese, Filipino, Japanese, Korean, and Vietnamese)",
    BlackAA "Black or African American",
    HispAndorLatino "Hispanic and/or Latino",
    MiddleEasternNorth "Middle Eastern or North African",
    NativeHawaiianPacific "Native Hawaiian or Pacific Islander (includes Samoan, Guamanian, and Chamorro)",
    WhiteCauc "White or Caucasian",
    OtherSpecNotListed "Other not listed (specify)" other(use OtherSpecNotListed ) fix,
    PreferNotSay "Prefer not to say" fix exclusive
} ran
helperfields (
    OtherSpecNotListed ""
    text;
);
